entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: The hydra-god of Naya, worshipped by the Cylian elves; wounded by Cylia into a five-headed hydra and dormant for millennia until the planes merge.

entities.name: Mayael the Anima
entities.description: A young female Cylian elf who is the Anima, spiritual interpreter of Progenitus, and rallies an army of elves and gargantuans.

entities.name: Cylia
entities.description: The first Anima, a shaman's youngest daughter who wounded Progenitus with a poisoned dagger and gained an eternal connection to him.

entities.name: The Cylian elves
entities.description: Nayan elves who devote themselves to Progenitus and monitor the Valley of the Ancient.

entities.name: The previous Anima
entities.description: The dying Anima who named Mayael her successor at the Sacellum.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara, a jungle paradise where gargantuans walk and elves worship Progenitus.

entities.name: Valley of the Ancient
entities.description: Jungle valley in Naya where Progenitus slumbers beneath three steam vents.

entities.name: The Sacellum
entities.description: A temple crafted from the living trees of the jungle.

entities.name: The Conflux
entities.description: The merging of the Alara shards, bringing new mana and chaos.

entities.name: The Whitecover Gaze
entities.description: The ritual that clouds the eyes of the Anima pearl-white and reveals the building blocks of creation.

entities.name: Gargantuans
entities.description: Behemoth creatures of Naya that the elves believe express Progenitus's will.

entities.name: Godtrackers
entities.description: Elf warriors who track the movements of the gargantuans and report to Mayael.

entities.name: Epicists
entities.description: Elves who write oral epics recording the gargantuans' behavior.

entities.name: Valley Wards
entities.description: Elves who watch the Valley of the Ancient from treetop camps and communicate by wooden pipes.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose castles intruded into Naya.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose tar pits intruded into Naya.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose necropolises blasted into Jund.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: A shard of Alara whose seas seeped into Bant.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: The reunited plane of the five shards.

events.summary: The previous Anima summons Mayael to the Sacellum, names her successor and explains the Whitecover Gaze ritual.
events.quote: the Anima named Mayael as her successor and told the girl what was required of her

events.summary: Mayael undergoes the Whitecover Gaze and experiences the memories of all the Anima and a vision of the beginning of time.
events.quote: her mind surged with the memories of all the Anima, going back to the very first

events.summary: In the vision, Progenitus unleashes five storms to consume creation; Cylia begs him to stop and is blinded by him.
events.quote: Furious at her impudence, Progenitus blinded the young girl

events.summary: Cylia flings a poisoned dagger into her mystical connection to Progenitus, scattering his essence and forming his five-headed hydra body, which falls dormant.
events.quote: she flung her poisoned dagger straight into its ethereal heart

events.summary: Alara's shards converge; Bant, Jund, Grixis and Esper intrude into one another and Mayael rallies an army against the invaders.
events.quote: Mayael rallied her army of elves and gargantuans

events.summary: New mana stirs the withered heads of Progenitus; the earth cracks and Progenitus rises with his body restored as Mayael arrives.
events.quote: His earthly tomb now open, Progenitus arched into the sky.

events.summary: Mayael is not afraid and concludes the Anima's task is complete, seeing Progenitus as the world made flesh.
events.quote: He is the world made flesh.

relations.note: As Anima, she discerns his will.
relations.quote: As the Anima, Mayael is in charge of discerning the will of Progenitus.

relations.note: She wounded him with a poisoned dagger.
relations.quote: she flung her poisoned dagger straight into its ethereal heart
They report back regularly to Mayael.

relations.note: Manifestations of him that walk the earth.
relations.quote: manifestations of him walk the earth in the form of gargantuans

relations.note: Elves devote their lives to the hydra.
relations.quote: Many elves devote their lives to the hydra, doing whatever they can to understand his will and keep him at peace.
